subject: Include a legend with Greeks letters

messages.subject: Include a legend with Greeks letters
parts:
Dear all:

Currently I am creating a graphic using ggplot with the code below.
With the function "geom_text()" I have added the individual means of
each density plot, nevertheless I would like to add in front of the
value a Greek letter indicating the parameter. I attempt so using the
functions "expression" and "paste" within the "geom_text" function,
but I got a message regarding a missing "aes". I assume that at some
point I should include the function "aes()" nonetheless I have no idea
how.

does anyone has a suggestion on how to do it?

best regards,

Sergio René


### Read data
data<- read.csv("th_Hansen_Seo_1.csv")
mode(data)
attach(data)
names(data)
dim(data)



### call the libraries
library("ggplot2")
library(reshape)

### generates the labels in greek letters
my.labs<-list(bquote(beta==hat(beta)),bquote(beta==1))

### creates data subsets
data1=subset(data, abs(Threshold)<25) #### for looking the [-25,25]
window
data_250=subset(data,t<251) ##### subsets for 250
data_500=subset(data,t>251) ##### subsets for 500
data_250_0=subset(data_250, Restriction<1) #### subset 250 no
restriction on Beta
data_250_1=subset(data_250, Restriction>0) #### subset 250 restriction
on Beta
data_500_0=subset(data_500, Restriction<1) #### subset 250 no
restriction on Beta
data_500_1=subset(data_500, Restriction>0) #### subset 250 restriction
on Beta

### creates mean values for each subset
dfs_250_0<-recast(data_250_0,p.value+Pi~variable, fun.aggregate=mean)
dfs_250_1<-recast(data_250_1,p.value+Pi~variable, fun.aggregate=mean)
dfs_500_0<-recast(data_500_0,p.value+Pi~variable, fun.aggregate=mean)
dfs_500_1<-recast(data_500_1,p.value+Pi~variable, fun.aggregate=mean)

### True threshold

value=-2

#### creates the graphic for 250 observations
d <- qplot(Threshold,data=subset(data_250,abs(Threshold)<30),
geom="density", colour=Beta) +
facet_wrap(p.value~Pi)+
xlab(expression(theta))+
scale_colour_manual(values=1:2,breaks=c("b=b","b=1"),labels=my.labs)+
geom_vline(data=dfs_250_0, aes(xintercept=Threshold), color="red")+
geom_vline(data=dfs_250_1, aes(xintercept=Threshold), color="black")+
geom_vline(xintercept=-2, color="blue")+
geom_text(data=dfs_250_0, aes(x=8,y=0.3, label=round(Threshold,
2)),size=3, colour="red")+
geom_text(data=dfs_250_1, aes(x=8,y=0.25, label=round(Threshold,
2)),size=3, colour="black")+
geom_text(aes(x=8, y= 0.35, label=value), size=3, colour="blue")

grob <- ggplotGrob(d)

strip_elem <- grid.ls(getGrob(grob, "strip.text.x", grep=TRUE,
global=TRUE))$name

grob <- geditGrob(grob, strip_elem[1],
label=expression(paste(alpha,"=0.10",", ",pi[0],"=0.05")))
grob <- geditGrob(grob, strip_elem[2],
label=expression(paste(alpha,"=0.05",", ",pi[0],"=0.05")))
grob <- geditGrob(grob, strip_elem[3],
label=expression(paste(alpha,"=0.01",", ",pi[0],"=0.05")))
grob <- geditGrob(grob, strip_elem[4],
label=expression(paste(alpha,"=0.10",", ",pi[0],"=0.10")))
grob <- geditGrob(grob, strip_elem[5],
label=expression(paste(alpha,"=0.05",", ",pi[0],"=0.10")))
grob <- geditGrob(grob, strip_elem[6],
label=expression(paste(alpha,"=0.01",", ",pi[0],"=0.10")))
grob <- geditGrob(grob, strip_elem[7],
label=expression(paste(alpha,"=0.10",", ",pi[0],"=0.15")))
grob <- geditGrob(grob, strip_elem[8],

Dear all, sorry for the double posting. I was recommended to include
on the code provided an example of the data used. As for that I
included a set of artificial data for my example.
I am working with simulations and I am plotting the densities of
estimated parameters (thresholds) using two time dimensions lengths,
250 and 500. The shape of the distribution is separated on the basis
of the level of significance of the estimated parameter (p.value) and
a trimming parameter (Pi). Furthermore the estimation can be done with
and without restriction.
What I want to do is add to each density not only the line and values
of the "true", "average with restriction" and "average without
restriction" threshold parameters. But also I would like to add near
to each value a Greek letter showing the parameter, i.e.
"theta[beta=1]". I am wondering if there is a way to do this using the
function "geom_text". I tried by combining such a function with the
functions "expression" and "paste" but does not work. does anyone has
an idea on how to achieve such result?

All the best,

Sergio René Araujo-Enciso


##### Example non-actual data
Threshold<-rnorm(7200,-2,1)
p.value<-rep(c(rep(c("p.value=0.9"),12),rep(c("p.value=0.95"),
12),rep(c("p.value=0.99"),12)),200)#### level of significance
Pi<-rep(c(rep(c("p=0.05"),4),rep(c("p=0.01"),4),rep(c("p=0.15"),4)),
600) ##### trimming parameter
Beta<-rep(c(rep(c("b=1"),2),rep(c("b=b"),2)),1800) #### label for
restriction
Restriction<-rep(c(rep(c(1),2),rep(c(0),2)),1800)#### value for
restriction
t<-rep(c(250,500),3600)
data<-data.frame(Threshold, p.value, Pi, Beta, Restriction, t)

### call the libraries
library("ggplot2")
library(reshape)

### generates the labels in greek letters
my.labs<-list(bquote(beta==hat(beta)),bquote(beta==1))

data_250=subset(data,t<251) ##### subsets for 250
data_500=subset(data,t>251) ##### subsets for 500
data_250_0=subset(data_250, Restriction<1) #### subset 250 no
restriction on Beta
data_250_1=subset(data_250, Restriction>0) #### subset 250 restriction
on Beta
data_500_0=subset(data_500, Restriction<1) #### subset 250 no
restriction on Beta
data_500_1=subset(data_500, Restriction>0) #### subset 250 restriction
on Beta


### creates mean values for each subset
dfs_250_0<-recast(data_250_0,p.value+Pi~variable, fun.aggregate=mean)
dfs_250_1<-recast(data_250_1,p.value+Pi~variable, fun.aggregate=mean)
dfs_500_0<-recast(data_500_0,p.value+Pi~variable, fun.aggregate=mean)
dfs_500_1<-recast(data_500_1,p.value+Pi~variable, fun.aggregate=mean)


### True threshold
value=-2


#### creates the graphic for 250 observations

geom="density", colour=Beta) +
facet_wrap(p.value~Pi)+
xlab(expression(theta))+
scale_colour_manual(values=1:2,breaks=c("b=b","b=1"),labels=my.labs)+
geom_vline(data=dfs_250_0, aes(xintercept=Threshold), color="red")+
geom_vline(data=dfs_250_1, aes(xintercept=Threshold), color="black")+
geom_vline(xintercept=-2, color="blue")+

geom_text(data=dfs_250_0, aes(x=4,y=0.3, label=round(Threshold,
2)),size=4,colour="red")+
geom_text(data=dfs_250_1, aes(x=4,y=0.25, label=round(Threshold,
2)),size=4,colour="black")+
geom_text(aes(x=4, y= 0.35, label=value), size=4, colour="blue")

grob_250 <- ggplotGrob(plot_250)

strip_elem_250 <- grid.ls(getGrob(grob_250, "strip.text.x", grep=TRUE,
global=TRUE))$name

grob_250 <- geditGrob(grob_250, strip_elem_250[1],

#### Save the graphic for 250 observations
png(file="Hansen_Seo_Test_Threshold_250.png", bg="transparent", width
= 460, height = 460)
grid.draw(grob_250)
dev.off()


### creates graphic for 500 observations

plot_500 <- qplot(Threshold,data=subset(data_500,abs(Threshold)<15),

geom_vline(data=dfs_500_0, aes(xintercept=Threshold), color="red")+
geom_vline(data=dfs_500_1, aes(xintercept=Threshold), color="black")+
geom_vline(xintercept=-2, color="blue")+
geom_text(data=dfs_500_0, aes(x=4,y=0.3, label=round(Threshold,
2)),size=4,colour="red")+
geom_text(data=dfs_500_1, aes(x=4,y=0.25, label=round(Threshold,
2)),size=4,colour="black")+
geom_text(aes(x=4, y= 0.35, label=value), size=4,colour="blue")

grob_500 <- ggplotGrob(plot_500)

strip_elem_500 <- grid.ls(getGrob(grob_500, "strip.text.x", grep=TRUE,
global=TRUE))$name

grob_500 <- geditGrob(grob_500, strip_elem_500[1],

#### Save the graphic for 500 observations
png(file="Hansen_Seo_Test_Threshold_500.png", bg="transparent", width
= 460, height = 460)
grid.draw(grob_500)
dev.off()

You want to add parse=TRUE to the geom_text call. Then it will treat
the label as an expression:

ggplot(data.frame(x=c(0,1),y=c(1,0)), aes(x,y)) +
geom_point() +
geom_text(aes(x=0.5, y=0.5,
label=paste("theta[beta==1] == ", -2, sep="")),
parse=TRUE)

See more comments below.

> All the best,
